rules.statement: A mortgagee's act of bidding at a sale of mortgaged land does not necessarily constitute an unequivocal representation that there is no existing mortgage, and failure to disclose the mortgage does not prevent the mortgagee from asserting their interest.
rules.supporting_quote: "If, as I think, the act of bidding does not work an estoppel, still less can the failure of the plaintiff to disclose his mortgage prevent him from now asserting his interest."
